title: Long non-coding RNAs in human dental pulp stem cell differentiation: Mechanisms and therapies.
snippet: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) regulate human dental pulp stem cell (hDPSC) differentiation and stress responses, offering potential targets for dentin-pulp regeneration. This narrative review critically evaluates their roles in self-renewal and osteogenic/odontogenic commitment, distinguishing direct hDPSC evidence from findings in other cell populations.....
